blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines–Sisi Rondina-Rosales relished having a complete Choco Mucho lineup as the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series reaches its crucial phase. With its full roster available, the Flying Titans finally claimed a long-awaited second win over sister team Creamline last Thursday, with Rondina-Rosales leading the way with 20 points. “This conference, we have a complete lineup, and whoever Coach puts on the court delivers.
